title: vtc-00: participant id=userId collides across calls
description: draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:277 SHOULD use userId as VTCParticipant id 'within a given call'; ids must be unique per type per account, so a user's records in two calls collide. Id syntax tracked in jmap-chat-spec-pcoc; resolution depends on the cross-account decision.
close_reason: VTCParticipant ids are server-assigned; found by callId+userId query.
